fields.name: tokenId
fields.label: Token ID
fields.note: Use an API token from Modal Settings → API Tokens. Personal and service user tokens use the same connection method.

fields.name: tokenSecret
fields.label: Token Secret
fields.note: Use a token with access to the Modal workspace and environments you need.

config.hint: Use MODAL_TOKEN_ID and MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET with the Modal CLI or SDK to manage deployments and invoke Functions. Create personal tokens in Settings or with modal token new. Service user tokens use the same variables.

fields.name: proxyTokenId
fields.label: Proxy Token ID
fields.note: Use a Proxy Token from Modal Settings → Proxy Tokens.

fields.name: proxyTokenSecret
fields.label: Proxy Token Secret
fields.note: Use the secret paired with this Proxy Token ID.

config.hint: Authenticate HTTP requests to Modal Endpoints, Servers and protected Web Functions with MODAL_PROXY_TOKEN as a Bearer token, or with Modal-Key and Modal-Secret headers using the separate outputs.
